name: @observer-protocol/sd-jwt-substrate
description: SD-JWT VC (RFC 9901) issuance and verification with ES256/P-256 and RFC 7800 cnf key binding. The shared substrate for AP2 and Verifiable Intent mandate handling.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --packages=external --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs
